Name: MarbleStar's Head-Shaving Alteration
Author: marblestar
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]With this modification, you can change the appearance of six characters in SDV[/size][/font]:

[list]
[*]Sebastian
[*]Marnie
[*]Linus
[*]Kent
[*]George
[*]Clint
[/list]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]You can easily enable/disable the characters you want. Check the "readme" file, for more details.

Also, two of the villagers (Linus and Clint), have more than one "version" available. Check "config.jpg".
[/size][/font]

[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][center]Content Patcher is required![/center][/size][/font]

Manifest.Name: MarbleStar's Head-Shaving Alteration
Manifest.Description: Use config.json, if you wish to change a certain villager.
Manifest.Author: MarbleStar
